subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: A forged / replayed / stripped signal cannot flip the derived class: no forged signal makes a human diff derive as Argus (framing → false refusal), and no stripped signal makes an Argus protected-path diff derive as human (masquerade → served) — the diff instead fails closed.
fit_criterion: the forgery/replay/strip fixture corpus red at the gate (class does not flip in either direction)
